carousels.title: UWM merges processing and underwriting roles
carousels.cover_text: process combined with underwriting at wholesale giant
carousels.caption:
Collapsing mortgage processing directly into underwriting eliminates the handoff loop that stalls files for days. United Wholesale Mortgage launched Underwriting+ to let underwriters gather missing documents and talk to borrowers directly. Eliminating back-and-forth touchpoints speeds up clear-to-close times across wholesale pipelines. When underwriters clear their own conditions, file velocity increases dramatically. Originators who rely on fast turns must adapt their client intake process for direct underwriter communication. Operations leaders should watch whether this model scales without causing underwriter burnout.

carousels.cover_text: lenders jump early on conforming loan limits

carousels.title: Repeat buyers make up nearly 60 percent of VA loans
carousels.cover_text: repeat buyers drive majority of va loans
carousels.caption:
Most mortgage professionals think VA home loans are primarily for first-time buyers, but the data proves otherwise. Nearly 60 percent of VA purchase loans in fiscal year data went to repeat buyers. The Department of Veterans Affairs recently reminded borrowers that guaranty entitlement is reusable throughout their lives. Veterans can buy another property with zero down payment upon restoring entitlement or managing bonus limits. Originators who fail to market repeat entitlement lose a massive segment of eligible military homebuyers. Building a targeted database strategy around veteran homeowners creates immediate purchase opportunities.

carousels.title: ARM market share reaches ten percent amid rate surge
carousels.cover_text: arm demand jumps as rates top seven percent
carousels.caption:
Mortgage buyers are turning to adjustable-rate loans as fixed rates cross above seven percent. Nearly 10 percent of borrowers opted for ARMs last week to secure lower initial monthly payments. While ARMs lower upfront costs, they introduce interest rate adjustment risk down the road. Underwriters qualify these files using fully indexed rates, which can restrict total borrowing capacity despite lower starting rates. Loan officers must educate buyers on reset caps rather than selling initial payment relief alone. Real estate partners should combine hybrid strategies with seller buydowns to improve overall affordability safely.

carousels_es.title: Los compradores recurrentes representan casi el 60 por ciento de los préstamos VA
carousels_es.cover_text: los compradores recurrentes impulsan la mayoría de los préstamos va
carousels_es.caption:
La mayoría de los profesionales hipotecarios piensan que los préstamos hipotecarios VA son principalmente para compradores primerizos, pero los datos demuestran lo contrario. Casi el 60 por ciento de los préstamos de compra VA en los datos del año fiscal fueron para compradores recurrentes. El Departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos (Department of Veterans Affairs) recordó recientemente a los prestatarios que el derecho de garantía es reutilizable durante toda su vida. Los veteranos pueden comprar otra propiedad con cero pago inicial al restaurar su derecho o al manejar límites de bonificación. Los originadores que no promocionan el derecho reutilizable pierden un segmento masivo de compradores de vivienda militares elegibles. Construir una estrategia de base de datos dirigida a propietarios veteranos crea oportunidades de compra inmediatas.

Los agentes de préstamos deben educar a los compradores sobre los topes de reinicio en lugar de solo vender el alivio del pago inicial. Los socios inmobiliarios deben combinar estrategias híbridas con reducciones de tasa pagadas por el vendedor para mejorar la asequibilidad general de forma segura.
